# `tfctl profile profiles rename` reference

Rename an existing profile.

## Usage

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles rename NAME --new_name=NEW_NAME [options]
```

## Description

The `tfctl profile profiles rename` command renames an existing profile. All configuration and settings are preserved; only the profile name changes.

## Arguments

- `NAME` - (Required) The name of the profile to rename.

## Required Flags

- `--new_name` - Specifies the new name of the profile.
  - Required.
  - Data type: string.
  - Must follow profile naming rules (start with letter, contain only letters, digits, and underscores, max 64 characters).

## Examples

### Rename a profile

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles rename my-profile --new_name=new-profile
```

### Rename the active profile

```shell-session
$ tfctl profile profiles rename default --new_name=production
```

## Profile Naming Rules

The new profile name must follow these rules:
- Start with a letter (a-z, A-Z)
- Contain only letters (a-z, A-Z), digits (0-9), and underscores (_)
- Maximum length of 64 characters

## Notes

- All profile configuration and settings are preserved during the rename.
- If the renamed profile is the active profile, it remains active after the rename.
- The new name must not conflict with an existing profile name.
- Use `tfctl profile profiles list` to see all existing profile names.
